context: A quiet office cafeteria, twelve-thirty. Yuki has come down with her bento; Asuka (visiting the building for a separate meeting) recognises her from a friend-of-a-friend introduction last month.
purpose: small lunch encounter — half-strangers, finding common ground

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: あれ…田中さん、ですよね？
lines.en: Oh — Ms. Tanaka, is that right?
lines.style: Soft, uncertain recognition flickering across her face. Lunch tray pauses mid-gesture. Polite, searching tone. Testing memory.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: えっ…木村さん。…先月の、お食事の。
lines.en: Oh! Ms. Kimura. …From last month's dinner.
lines.style: Small rush of genuine pleasure breaking through. Sets her bento down carefully. Warm realization settling into her voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良かった、覚えてもらえてて。一緒に座っても？
lines.en: I'm glad you remembered. Do you mind sitting with me?
lines.style: Steady, genuinely kind — no performance in it. Warm directness. The invitation of someone used to putting others at ease.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: もちろん。…本当に、奇遇ですね。
lines.en: Of course. …What a lovely coincidence, really.
lines.style: Genuine delight in the surprise. Voice carries the full moment — unhurried, present. A small smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日、こちらでミーティングで。
lines.en: I've got a meeting here today, actually.
lines.style: Light, contextual — matter-of-fact without coldness. Settling into the conversation. Natural breath, no rushing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お忙しい中、いつもありがとうございます。
lines.en: Thank you for all you do, truly.
lines.style: Earnest gratitude, reflexive but unperformed. Quiet sincerity. Gentle delivery — not self-deprecating, just genuinely meant.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 田中さんも、最近お元気？
lines.en: And how have you been? Lately?
lines.style: Steady, genuinely attentive inquiry. Open presence. She's not filling silence — she's actually waiting to hear.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 元気です。…本当に、少しずつ。
lines.en: I'm doing well. …Truly, getting better, little by little.
lines.style: Honest, unhurried answer. No rush. Slight warmth in the admission of gradual progress. Voice settles into the moment.
